definitions.RECORDED_REFERENCE_NAME: A retained source names a path/basename, or an operator recovery associates a report with a protocol, without a prior exact report-SHA-256 binding. It must never be interpreted as cryptographic report custody.
definitions.RETAINED_SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_ONLY: A retained companion generator source names the report output path, but does not bind the generated report bytes or prove which execution produced them. This is a non-cryptographic generator/output-name relationship and must never be interpreted as a prior report receipt.
definitions.VERIFIED_BINDER_IDENTITY: The inventory verified the exact SHA-256 field in the identified retained binder bytes. Binder custody is reported separately and may be only a local snapshot; this status does not make an untracked/modified binder canonical.
definitions.exact_expected_artifact_present: True means retained bytes match a prior binder containing the exact report SHA-256 (and expected size when separately known); false means such a prior-bound artifact is absent or a same-basename file has wrong bytes; null means no prior cryptographic report binder was found.
definitions.raw_timing_sample_arrays_present: True only when a JSON key containing sample/samples maps to a nonempty numeric array, or a numeric seconds/*_seconds array is nested under a timing/timings path. Min/median/max summaries and scalar calibration values do not count.

recovered_report_inventory.scope: 84 unique comparator-relevant historical JSON report basenames: the 76-name v2 recovery set, six exact-bound translational/EIH outcome-blind-chain artifacts, one name/semantic-digest-bound GR15 100-year same-model validation report, and one unbound current 100-year same-model EIH timing prior

objective: Measure a finite, accuracy-gated JX-versus-current-REBOUND portfolio; preserve every loss and capability gap; optimize without weakening physics, outputs, tolerances, or resource accounting.
